candidates.formal_type:
∀ {n : Nat} {adj : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Int},
  Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n adj →
    ∀ {Q : Quiver.{u_1, 0} (Fin n)},
      Etingof.IsOrientationOf.{u_1} Q adj → Exists.{1} fun ordering => Etingof.IsAdmissibleOrdering.{u_1} Q ordering

∀ {n : Nat} (Q : Quiver.{u_1, 0} (Fin n)) (σ : List.{0} (Fin n)),
  Etingof.IsAdmissibleOrdering.{u_1} Q σ →
    ∀ (M j : Nat),
      LE.le.{0} j (List.length.{0} σ) →
        ∀ (m : Nat)
          (hm :
            LT.lt.{0} m
              (List.length.{0}
                (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} (List.flatten.{0} (List.replicate.{0} M σ)) (List.take.{0} j σ)))),
          Etingof.IsSink.{0, u_1} (Fin n)
            (List.get.{0} (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} (List.flatten.{0} (List.replicate.{0} M σ)) (List.take.{0} j σ))
              ⟨m, hm⟩)

source_text: Every Dynkin orientation admits the repeated admissible sink ordering used in the reflection-functor proof.
